sql:
-- Android D0 through 19:00 Beijing time. Boss failure proxy: same section's first stage appears again.
WITH
tc_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_android AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
sg_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
raw AS (
  SELECT 'TC Android' AS cohort,v."#account_id" AS account_id,v."#event_time" AS event_time,v."#event_name" AS event_name,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS event_id,
    TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].after AS DOUBLE) AS item_after
  FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND b.user_id IS NULL AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 19:00:00'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'SG Android',v."#account_id",v."#event_time",v."#event_name",CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER),CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT),TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].after AS DOUBLE)
  FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN sg_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id INNER JOIN sg_country c ON v."#user_id"=c.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND b.user_id IS NULL AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 19:00:00'
),
cohort_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT cohort,account_id FROM raw WHERE event_name='new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL),
events AS (SELECT r.* FROM raw r JOIN cohort_users c ON r.cohort=c.cohort AND r.account_id=c.account_id),
main_stage AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,event_id AS stage_code FROM events
  WHERE event_name='stage_fight' AND stage_type=1001 AND event_id IS NOT NULL
),
first_stage AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,stage_code,CAST(FLOOR(stage_code/10) AS BIGINT) AS section_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort,account_id,CAST(FLOOR(stage_code/10) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY event_time) AS first_stage_attempt
  FROM main_stage WHERE MOD(stage_code,10)=1
),
boss_fail AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,section_code,section_code*10+5 AS boss_stage_code,event_time AS reentry_time
  FROM first_stage WHERE first_stage_attempt>=2
),
boss_attempt AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,stage_code AS boss_stage_code FROM main_stage WHERE MOD(stage_code,10)=5 GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
ticket_before_fail AS (
  SELECT f.cohort,f.account_id,f.section_code,f.reentry_time,
    MAX_BY(e.item_after,e.event_time) AS ticket_balance_at_fail
  FROM boss_fail f LEFT JOIN events e
    ON f.cohort=e.cohort AND f.account_id=e.account_id AND e.event_name='item_change' AND e.event_id=10238 AND e.event_time<=f.reentry_time
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
fail_user_stage AS (
  SELECT f.cohort,f.account_id,f.boss_stage_code,
    MIN(CASE WHEN t.ticket_balance_at_fail=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ticket_empty_at_fail,
    MIN(CASE WHEN t.ticket_balance_at_fail IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ticket_snapshot_missing
  FROM boss_fail f LEFT JOIN ticket_before_fail t ON f.cohort=t.cohort AND f.account_id=t.account_id AND f.section_code=t.section_code AND f.reentry_time=t.reentry_time
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT a.cohort,a.boss_stage_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS boss_challengers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.account_id) AS fail_users,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT f.account_id)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id),0),1) AS fail_rate_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.ticket_empty_at_fail=1 THEN f.account_id END) AS ticket_empty_fail_users,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.ticket_empty_at_fail=1 THEN f.account_id END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.account_id),0),1) AS ticket_empty_among_fail_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.ticket_snapshot_missing=1 THEN f.account_id END) AS missing_ticket_snapshot_fail_users
FROM boss_attempt a LEFT JOIN fail_user_stage f ON a.cohort=f.cohort AND a.account_id=f.account_id AND a.boss_stage_code=f.boss_stage_code
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2;
